description.fun: A little lump of rock salt born deep underground in layers of salt. As it travels, the ground scrapes salt off its body, but it keeps making more, and the trails it leaves have been called 'salt roads' since long ago. People used to treasure Nacli for the salt it shared, and its gentle-flavoured salt still goes into food today, even ice cream.
description.guide: A Rock-type Pokémon made of rock salt from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, designed by Hitoshi Ariga. Nacli constantly makes salt in its body and leaves trails of it behind. It evolves into Naclstack and then Garganacl.
description.tagline: A walking lump of rock salt that leaves salty trails

description.fun: Naclstack compresses the rock salt inside its body into hard pellets and fires them with enough force to punch through an iron sheet. It dry-cures its prey by spraying it with salt, then, being rather absent-minded, forgets where it left it, and often forgets its Trainer's orders too. People gather the salt from its footprints to season their sandwiches.
description.guide: The middle stage of Nacli's line, a four-legged Rock-type Pokémon made of rock salt. It shoots hardened salt pellets and salt-cures its prey.
description.tagline: A forgetful salt block that cures its prey

description.fun: A gentle giant of rock salt. When a Pokémon is hurt, Garganacl rubs its fingertips together and sprinkles it with mineral-rich salt, and even severe wounds heal promptly, so many Pokémon gather around hoping for a lick. Its healing salt may play on 'salt curing' and 'rubbing salt in the wound', and its cry grunts three notes of the Pokémon Center tune.
description.guide: The final evolution of Nacli, a large Rock-type Pokémon made of rock salt and sedimentary rock. Its mineral-rich salt is said to heal wounds and keep people healthy.
description.tagline: A salt giant whose sprinkles heal wounds
